plan.notes: DEGREE HONESTY: Cape Cod Community College does NOT offer an AS in Computer Science. The official degree is Associate in Arts (AA), Computer Science Concentration (2026-2027 Academic Catalog, p.102; catalog Degree Type line: 'Associate in Arts'). Program page confirms: 'The Associate in Arts degree does not indicate a specialized degree in a concentration.' True degree type AA used throughout. SOURCE: official 2026-2027 Academic Catalog PDF downloaded 2026-09-30 from CCCC's official catalog host (live-capecod.cleancatalog.io, successor to catalog.capecod.edu); Computer Science Concentration requirements sequence on p.102. Course titles, credits, and prerequisites cross-checked against the same catalog's course-descriptions section. TRANSCRIPTION METHOD: pdftotext extraction of official PDF, term-by-term transcription; choice rows preserved as choice slots with all printed options documented. CREDIT MATH: catalog prints 'Total Credits 60-67' because many rows are ranges (CSC110/CSC120/CSC105 3-4, CSC125/ENR110 3-4, MAT245/MAT220 3-4, STEM electives 3-4, CSC240-or-Elective 0-4). This plan uses the recommended choices — CSC110 (3), CSC125 (4), CSC240 (4; catalog recommends CSC240 for UMass-Dartmouth/UMass-Amherst transfer), MAT245 (3), 3-credit STEM electives — which sums to 65, inside the published 60-67 range. A student's actual total varies 60-67 by choice; sequence total here is the representative 65-credit path. PREREQ CAVEATS (placement/assessment, not codified as external_prereqs): MAT240 requires C- or higher in MAT195 Precalculus with Trigonometry or satisfactory basic-skills assessment score; ENL101 subject to placement; students who place into developmental math/English must begin the course sequence in the first semester and may need additional semesters. CSC230 is offered Fall; CSC125 offered Fall; sequence assumes Fall entry, so Third Semester = Fall Year 2. The 2026-2027 catalog shows no M (milestone) designations; milestone field omitted.
